name: Simulated psychiatric interviews train an intake model
title: Simulated psychiatric interviews train an intake model
summary: A Google paper trains a language model with multi-turn reinforcement learning against simulated psychiatric patients, rewarding diagnosis, communication, and clinical safety. In blinded evaluations where psychiatrists role-played patients, the trained model won 76.7% of comparisons, and appropriate differential diagnoses rose from 33.3% to 68.3%.

In blinded sessions where psychiatrists played patients, the trained model won 76.7% of comparisons, appropriate differential diagnoses rose from 33.3% to 68.3%, and patient-centered communication rose from 65.2% to 82.0%.
